Based on my analysis of the Q3 2025 quarterly report (quarterly_report_q3_2025.pdf), here are the key financial metrics with year-over-year comparisons:

## Revenue Performance
- **Total Revenue**: $4.2B (Q3 2025) vs $3.75B (Q3 2024) — **+12% YoY**
- **Recurring Revenue**: $3.1B (+18% YoY)
- **Services Revenue**: $1.1B (+2% YoY)

## Profitability Metrics
- **Gross Margin**: 68.5% (up from 66.2% in Q3 2024)
- **Operating Income**: $890M (+8% YoY)
- **Operating Margin**: 21.2% (improved from 19.8%)
- **Net Income**: $742M (+11% YoY)

## Per Share Data
- **EPS (Diluted)**: $2.15 (beat consensus estimate of $2.08)
- **YoY EPS Growth**: +14%

## Cash Position
- **Free Cash Flow**: $1.1B
- **Cash & Equivalents**: $8.2B

## Key Observations
1. Strong enterprise segment growth driving revenue acceleration
2. Margin expansion reflects operational efficiency improvements
3. Recurring revenue growth outpacing overall revenue indicates improving business quality
